items.title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Deprecate transaction origins
items.summary: Dynamics 365 Project Operations streamlines transaction processing by replacing separate transaction origin records with direct source document references on transaction records, including journal lines, actuals, and invoice line details. This approach reduces the database operations required to maintain links to originating time entries, expenses, and material usage logs, and enables the phased retirement of transaction origin record creation.GA date: December CY2026Preview date: April CY2026

HR teams can reduce manual follow-ups, repeated data entry, and delays caused by incomplete information by using a structured process with configured validation and document requirements. A guided experience helps candidates understand what to do next, while HR administrators maintain a repeatable process that supports day-one readiness.

items.summary: When vouchers are generated through bank reconciliation rules, financial dimensions from the selected bank account are merged with the financial dimensions defined on the reconciliation rule. items.summary:

For trade counter and call center operations, orders often need to reach the warehouse quickly so that picking and fulfillment activities can begin without delay. Without a direct path from Commerce to the warehouse management system, staff must manually intervene on every order, which slows fulfillment and increases the risk of missed or delayed shipments.

Standing values such as a customer's purchase order number are retyped on every transaction. This release is designed to address those friction points.

Headquarters is where administrators configure label formats and the printers available to each store, and where headquarters users create and release those requests. items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Faster cube data loading with optimized dataflows
items.summary:
Business performance planning introduces an optimized dataflow capability designed to improve the performance of loading data into planning cubes.
The optimized dataflow improves how data is processed and loaded into the cube, reducing the time required to populate planning models, particularly when working with larger datasets.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Faster cube data loading with optimized dataflows
items.summary:
The Matrix visual now provides clearer control over how zero and blank values are handled during planning.
Users can explicitly save 0 as a planning value, preserving the underlying record with a value of zero. Users can also delete an existing planning record by clearing the cell and saving the blank value.
This behavior is supported when editing both leaf-level and parent-level cells, providing a consistent experience when users enter values directly or make adjustments at an aggregated levelM

items.title: Work IQ: Memory capabilities expand to agents
items.summary: A new Work IQ MCP path, /memory/me/coreMemories, gives authorized agents access to a user’s memory profile. This profile enables agents to provide more personalized and relevant assistance. At launch, it includes Custom Instructions, Saved Memories, relevant work account data, and memories derived from chat history. The memory profile will continue to evolve and improve over time.GA date: December CY2026

In B2B commerce, the company is the customer of record, but the individuals who place orders, make deposits, and collect goods can vary from transaction to transaction. Without a way to identify these individuals, retailers have limited visibility into who performed specific actions. This can create accountability gaps and make it more difficult to resolve disputes or meet compliance requirements.

items.summary:
Pricing managers can set margin controls that match how the business actually sells, instead of one threshold for everything. Each product, channel and customer gets the right margin guardrail.
With this feature, pricing managers can define margin thresholds based on price attributes such as product category, product attributes, channel and customer group. Each threshold can include three margin tiers: floor, target and ceiling. The tiers drive approvals for price overrides and manual discounts

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Unified Pricing Management - Set prices per price unit for low-value items
items.summary:
Businesses that sell small, low-value items, such as fasteners, electronic components or packaging, can maintain prices more easily and accurately, without rounding problems from tiny per-unit prices.
With this feature, Unified Pricing Management supports price units, so you can set a price per batch of units instead of per single unit. For example, you can price an item per 100 or 1,000 units. Unified Pricing Management then calculates the correct line amount from the order quantity.GA date: Ma

items.summary:
Retailers can protect their profitability without slowing down store operations. Sales associates can still adjust prices to close a sale. Any change that would push an item below the allowed margin goes to a manager for review, so discounting decisions stay controlled and consistent.

This feature brings available-to-promise (ATP) data from Inventory Visibility together with transfer lead times in Store Commerce, so associates can choose the best location and set accurate delivery dates. This feature includes:

ATP and estimated arrival in inventory lookup: View ATP quantities and dates across locations, plus the estimated arrival date
